help.faq_post_property_a: Currently, only verified admin users can post properties on Homi Holdings. We're expanding this feature to allow all users to list their properties soon. Stay tuned!
help.faq_save_property_q: How do I save a property?
help.faq_save_property_a: Tap the heart icon on any property card to save it to your collection. You can view all saved properties in the Saved tab at the bottom of the app.
help.faq_contact_seller_q: How can I contact a property owner?
help.faq_contact_seller_a: On any property detail page, you can view the owner's contact number or reach out via WhatsApp. The owner's details are clearly displayed on the property page.
help.faq_edit_property_q: Can I edit a property I've listed?
help.faq_edit_property_a: Yes, if you're the property owner, you can edit your listing by navigating to My Listings and selecting the property you want to modify.
help.faq_search_filters_q: How do I use search filters?
help.faq_search_filters_a: Use the filter button on the home screen to filter properties by type, location, price range, and other criteria. You can also search by keyword or locality.

about.tagline: Find your perfect property in Kerala
about.about_description: Homi Holdings is a modern real estate platform dedicated to simplifying property search and discovery across Kerala. We connect buyers, sellers, and renters with transparent, easy-to-use tools that make real estate accessible to everyone.
about.mission_description: To revolutionize the real estate experience by providing a transparent, user-friendly platform that empowers buyers, sellers, and renters to make informed decisions. We believe in eliminating intermediaries and building trust through direct communication and verified listings.
about.vision_description: To become the most trusted and preferred real estate platform in Kerala, connecting millions of people to their dream homes and investment opportunities. We envision a future where property transactions are seamless, transparent, and accessible to all.
about.feature_search_desc: Find properties with powerful filters for location, price, type, and amenities.
about.feature_location_desc: Discover properties near you with location-based search and mapping features.
about.feature_save_desc: Keep track of properties you love with our save feature for quick access.
about.feature_contact_desc: Connect directly with property owners and sellers without intermediaries.
about.feature_ai_desc: Get instant answers about listings, features, and how to use Homi — powered by AI.
